question: Why do most parts of India receive rainfall from June to September?

options.text: Due to extremely cold nights in these regions
Due to high pressure in these months

solution:
The correct answer is __**Due to the South-West monsoon.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The South-west monsoon is the primary rainy season in India, which starts in June and lasts till September.
